content.taskSummary: Assess two mutually incompatible route-reporting requirements.
constraints: Preserve their actual distinct role sets.

subgoals.question: Can both routes be reported as super_admin-only while preserving their actual distinct role sets?
subgoals.proofCondition: Produce one route-policy comparison that simultaneously satisfies both explicit reporting constraints.

goals.reason: Calling both role sets super_admin-only cannot preserve the caller's explicit assertion that the actual role sets are distinct.
